open_points.subject: Attempt numbering for owner refusal (A10 vs A11)
open_points.text: A10 rule 3: "Refusing writes one NodeExecution `refused_by_owner` for the refused element, with the next attempt number"; A11 rule 1: "attempt_number numbers the attempts... An attempt is one execution... or one send... Nothing else takes a number."
open_points.question: Does `refused_by_owner` consume an attempt number even though no execution/send attempt happened?
options: Yes, `refused_by_owner` is a numbered non-send/non-execution event.
No, only execution/send (and pre-send-failed send attempts) are numbered; refusal gets no new attempt number.
open_points.default_guess: Yes, keep A10 literal behavior and consume the next number for `refused_by_owner`.

open_points.subject: Attempt numbering for mapped-over-empty record (A13 vs A11)
open_points.text: A13 rule 6: "writes one NodeExecution `succeeded` that... is not an attempt and carries the fixed attempt number 1"; A11 rule 1: "Nothing else takes a number."
open_points.question: Is the mapped-empty synthetic success record an explicit exception that always carries attempt number 1?
options: Yes, treat mapped-empty as a special non-attempt record with fixed attempt number 1.
No, non-attempt records should not carry attempt numbers; remove or null this field there.
open_points.default_guess: Yes, treat it as an explicit special case with attempt number 1.

open_points.subject: EffectAttempt.authority for ordinary `draft-write` sends
open_points.text: M26 field: "`authority`: the approval or the grant it used"; A10 rule 1: "`draft-write` nodes ask nothing at run time" (except resend after `not_applied`).
open_points.question: What authority value is recorded for a normal `draft-write` attempt that uses neither approval nor standing grant?
options: Record a synthetic authority type (e.g., flow activation / owner activation decision).
open_points.default_guess: Allow `authority` to be absent/null for ordinary `draft-write` attempts.

open_points.subject: Config hot-reload scope after file change
open_points.text: A16 rule 2: "The kernel reads the token list again whenever the configuration file's content has changed..." and "A changed configuration that fails a check of the start makes every request refused"; A08 rule 6: "The manifest revision is read at start... only after a restart."
open_points.question: When config content changes at runtime, are only tokens reloaded, or all installation fields re-parsed and applied?
options: Reload only token list; other installation fields stay as-at-start until restart.
Re-parse full config each change and apply all valid fields immediately.
open_points.default_guess: Reload only tokens dynamically; keep other fields fixed until restart.

open_points.subject: Sandbox cleanup failure handling mode
open_points.text: A03 rule 7: "...execution is recorded `crashed`... and the kernel process stops"; A03 formal invariant: "cleanup_unconfirmed -> output_discarded AND sandbox_refuses_until_restart".
open_points.question: After `cleanup_failed`, must the process terminate immediately, or stay up but refuse sandbox work until restart?
options: Process remains up and returns sandbox-refusal errors until restart.
